metadata.description: Oh-My-Pi plugins: a persona-driven dev team and an Azure DevOps filesystem.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Persona-driven AI development team: 32 agents, 3-phase orchestration (specs/plan/build/pr), blocking guard extensions, and local small-tier model routing (Sonnet/Opus stay cloud).

plugins.name: azure-devops-fs
plugins.description: Azure DevOps as a filesystem for OMP: read repos/files/PRs/diffs via ado:// URIs, create/checkout/push PRs, comment/vote, watch pipelines. Standalone, PAT-authenticated, with a SQLite read cache.
